# Navchetna Charitable Trust

> Service, Support & Humanity — a charitable trust based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Overview

Navchetna Charitable Trust was established in 2009 with the service spirit and dedication of Shri Rupesh Kumar Modi. The Trust supports people in need through practical seva, with dignity and respect.

## Location

- Office: 30-FF, Harishiddh Chambers, Income Tax, Ashram Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380014
- Phone: +91 97125 17115
- Email: navchetnacharitabletrust09@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/navchetna_charitable_trust

## Current programs

1. Tree plantation
2. Food distribution (Food Seva / Bhandara) — meals shared with dignity
3. Gau seva — care and protection for cows
4. Helping the poor — food, clothes, and everyday essentials
5. Education support — hostel accommodation and study materials for students
